trafficSummary.active: Latest passive traffic snapshot from the runner interface.
trafficSummary.receiveHelp: Receive - traffic received by the interface.
trafficSummary.transmitHelp: Transmit - traffic sent by the interface.
trafficSummary.flowHelp: Header-only flows active in the latest snapshot.
trafficSummary.topHelp: Endpoint with the most observed traffic.

diagnostics.title: Latest on-demand measurement
diagnostics.description: Active on-demand measurements remain separate from Traffic and Health Watch.
diagnostics.unavailable: Diagnostic data could not be loaded.

trends.title: Network health trends
trends.description: Historical latency and packet loss from persisted Health Watch minute samples. No data is inferred or backfilled.
trends.noHistory: No historical data for this range.
trends.wait: Samples appear after a scheduled Health Watch probe has been published.
trends.targetUnavailable: The selected monitoring target is no longer available. Select another target.
trends.boundedRequest: Select at most 20 targets. This history request exceeds the supported bounds.
trends.authError: Health history could not be authenticated. Sign in again.
trends.queryError: Health history could not be loaded. Monitoring status is still available; retry by changing the range.
trends.metricUnavailable: History is available ({{count}} buckets), but latency is unavailable. Null measurements remain gaps, not zero.
trends.aggregation: Chart buckets: {{seconds}} seconds. Values are averages of stored observations; tooltip shows measured min/max and observation counts. Status is the worst observed state in the bucket.
trends.latencyHelp: Latency uses available ICMP measurements only. Missing latency remains a gap; offline history is retained.
trends.lossHelp: Packet loss comes from short windows of up to five probes. 0% is valid data; bucket averages are not a new probe count.
trends.intervals: Selected targets probe every {{intervals}} seconds. Routine publication is every 60 seconds (transitions may publish sooner); stored history uses one-minute buckets.
trends.allTargetsLimit: All-target history is limited to {{limit}} targets. A single target is selected; every target remains available individually.
trends.refreshHint: Refresh the selected history, at most once every 10 seconds.

map.title: Monitoring relationships from Local Runner

map.clickHelp: Click a target to see details

health.loadError: Network Health could not be loaded
health.loadErrorHelp: Check the local backend and PostgreSQL connection.
health.title: Known-target reachability
health.description: Lightweight ICMP status for approved inventory. Offline means the target did not respond after the threshold; it does not prove the device is powered off because ICMP may be blocked.
health.emptyHelp: Monitoring does not scan subnets. An operator must explicitly select an inventory device and runner.
health.recentHelp: Only meaningful status changes are shown; not one event for every ping.
health.icmpNotice: ICMP only confirms whether a response was received at probe time. A firewall, rate limit, or temporary path issue can produce offline status without proving that the device is powered off.
health.onDemandNotice: Diagnostics and active inspection remain on demand and never run automatically.
